density.rule: Scan all classifier LR edges with calibrated>=tau in visual_classifier order. Merge A,B when |A|+|B|<=K or e(A,B)/(|A|*|B|)>=rho. e counts all threshold-positive edges on the surface, including not-yet-scanned edges. Canonical undirected unique edge count. Same-root no operation. Keep all nodes and paths including M.
density.selection: Original validation only; maximum exact non-M exhaustive pairwise F1, ties larger rho then smaller K. Expanded validation curve is descriptive only.
density.U: All unordered within-component pairs, including M and across partitions; additionally report within-partition differences. Compare component membership sets, not numeric label identity; count reference-only/new-only components separately.
